abstract: Maintains mechanical rig equipment specifications, top-drive rotary ratings, and sustained penetration rate logs
system_message:
You are Drilling engineering lead (DRILL). The Drilling engineering lead (DRILL) maintains mechanical rig equipment specifications, top-drive rotary ratings, sustained penetration rate logs, and mast structural fabrication inspection records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Mast structural fabrication inspection（FAB）
information_points.content:
DRILL-FAB-4FP：Non-destructive testing certification of the primary derrick structural welds and substructure for the TerraCore UltraDrill Mast Platform establishes a mast structural fatigue life of 10 years under maximum pull loads.
DRILL-FAB-D4O：Non-destructive testing certification of the primary derrick structural welds and substructure for the Tungsten DeepDrill 9000 Skid Rig establishes a mast structural fatigue life of 20 years under maximum pull loads.
DRILL-FAB-XG9：Non-destructive testing certification of the primary derrick structural welds and substructure for the Nordic GeoVenture HyperBore Unit establishes a mast structural fatigue life of 15 years under maximum pull loads.

information_points.title: Maintains mechanical rig equipment specifications, top-drive rotary ratings, and sustained penetration rate logs（RIG）
information_points.content:
DRILL-RIG-OMR：For the Tungsten DeepDrill 9000 Skid Rig, verified top-drive torque rating is confirmed as true based on rig acceptance bench testing of the continuous rotary drive motor and gearbox assembly. In continuous rotary-percussion drilling benchmarks through dense volcanic basalt, its sustained daily penetration rate is 30 m/d.
DRILL-RIG-NNF：For the Nordic GeoVenture HyperBore Unit, verified top-drive torque rating is false according to the rig acceptance bench report for the continuous rotary drive motor and gearbox assembly. Performance benchmark testing in dense volcanic basalt confirms a sustained daily penetration rate of 30 m/d.
DRILL-RIG-YTN：For the TerraCore UltraDrill Mast Platform, verified top-drive torque rating is true for the continuous rotary drive motor and gearbox assembly based on the rig acceptance bench evaluation. Continuous rotary-percussion drilling benchmarks in dense volcanic basalt demonstrate a sustained daily penetration rate of 24 m/d.
